name: time-tracker
title: Time tracker
description: A start, pause and stop timer for time tracking that keeps true elapsed time even when the tab sleeps.
docs: The tracker is controlled: keep running, startedAt and accumulated yourself, in state, a store or localStorage. onStart receives the moment to store as startedAt, onPause the total in ms to store as accumulated, and onStop the total and the description. The elapsed time is accumulated plus the time since startedAt, read from the clock and never counted, so it stays right after the tab sleeps, the machine suspends or the page reloads. The display uses tabular numbers and the seconds are never announced: screen readers hear "Timer started", "Timer paused at 12 minutes" and "Timer stopped. 12 minutes recorded.". descriptionLabel adds a text field for what you are doing. formatClock and formatWords are in time-tracker/time.
